title: Wholesome Japanese Rice Bowl
description: A simple, pungent, and snappy Japanese dish featuring ghee and dashi-extract, perfect for a kid-friendly meal.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: replaced with ghee for a unique flavor

instructions: Rinse the Japanese short-grain rice thoroughly in a fine-mesh strainer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the 140g of Japanese short-grain rice and 260g of water.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 18 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
While the rice is cooking, heat 10g of ghee in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the 50g of dried shiitake mushrooms to the saucepan and saut5e until fragrant.
Add the 20g of dashi-extract, 5g of soy sauce, and 5g of maple syrup to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes or until the liquid has slightly thickened.
Fluff the cooked Japanese short-grain rice with a fork and stir in the sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
Divide the Japanese short-grain rice among four bowls.
Top each bowl with the shiitake mushroom dashi sauce and drizzle with toasted sesame oil.
